question: Radio broadcasting started in India in ________ by the Radio Club of Bombay (Mumbai).
solution:
The correct answer is **__1923__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 1923 is the year when radio broadcasting started in India.
 
• It was initiated by the Radio Club of Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• This marked the beginning of radio broadcasting in the country, which would later evolve into a major medium for communication and entertainment.
